description: Verifies the embedded Cash-Karp 5(4) and Vernier 9(8) integrators on a circular timelike Schwarzschild orbit: every adaptive step succeeds and the orbital radius remains constant to within the stated tolerance.

checks.label: every adaptive step over 50 units of proper time succeeds

the orbital radius stays at 12 within 1e-6
